note: Private resort on 29 acres along the Upper Iowa River near Dorchester, with a seasonal section in the back half of the park (about 115 seasonal sites beside the 46 nightly ones in the front half). Sand-bottom spring-fed swimming pool with a beach, canoe/kayak/tube rentals and shuttle, cabins. No cell service in the valley; campground Wi-Fi. No ATVs, UTVs or golf carts. --Claude
summary: Operator site (2026): $38-60 a night, water + 30A standard, 50/30A on A-E/15/37-41, FHU 132-135, books on CampLife (not Hipcamp), 2-night summer-weekend minimum, mid-Apr to mid-Oct, two dump stations. Map: 46 nightly sites, ~115 seasonal. Google 4.8 (176). Passes the private gate. Riverfront kept for the river row. Stored pin is a farm ~750 m SW.
flags: GATE: cheapest nightly RV site $38 (operator page, 2026; up to 4 guests, no other mandatory fee - the pool is included, day passes are for visitors only) - under $50. Presence: own working website with phone 563-568-3263 and a CampLife booking engine. Google Maps 4.8 from 176 reviews (578 Lonnings Dr). Good Sam: stored false (not a GS Park).

LONG-STAY: test 1 - the campground map keys about 115 of ~161 sites (46-153) 'Seasonal' and 46 (A-E, 01-41) as nightly electric/water, so ~29% nightly; the seasonal page sells '$2,500-$3,000 per season' with a waiting list. Test 2 passes (posted nightly rate). Test 3 passes (online booking engine). Test 4 passes (well over 1 site in 10 sold nightly). Test 5: no homes or memberships sold. The operator leads with camping and river trips, not seasonal living. I read it as a large seasonal section beside a real transient campground, not mostly seasonal in character; with 4.8/176 it is not a drop candidate.

BOOKING: stored platform 'hipcamp' is stale - the operator's 'Book Your Site' links to CampLife (https://www.camplife.com/Upper+Iowa+Resort?newres=y). Written as platform 'operator' with that url, since camplife is not in the platform vocabulary.

PIN: stored 43.4180,-91.5195 is a farmstead with grain bins ~750 m SW of the resort. The nightly sites run from the pool/office (~43.4233,-91.5147) north-west along the river to ~43.4250,-91.5170; re-pin to ~43.4241,-91.5155 (seen on imagery: the gravel loops, RVs and pool are visible).

WATERFRONT: riverfront kept. The Upper Iowa is ~55-65 m wide here. On Esri imagery (0.22 m/px) the river row (map sites 04-14 and 15-21, either side of the canoe landing) has RVs parked on the river side of the gravel lane with open mowed grass ~15-30 m to the bank and only scattered bank trees, no road or day use between. That is ~18 of the 46 nightly sites; the inner sites 22-41 and A-E sit behind the lane (view at best). The canoe landing between the two halves of the row is the resort's own launch, not a public day-use area, but sites beside it should be checked on any later re-audit.
